estimand: Country-framing and instruction-language effects on a fixed synthetic roster; not national populations or country-language interactions.
roster_status: Designed fictional adult roster, ages 18-67, seed 224. Independently shuffled declared marginals; no census or population-representative claim. No race labels or US parties. Political orientation is an operational left/center/right scale, not universally equivalent across countries.
candidate_language: Fixed English JSON field names and values in all four instruction languages
primary_contrasts: Within each method/model/repetition: other country framings versus US-English; other instruction languages versus US-English. Model pairs match method/country/language/repetition. Methods are whole protocols with different constraints.
uncertainty: Show both run values and their range. Two repetitions of one roster do not support reliable confidence intervals, population inference, or significance declarations.
rq2_scope: Descriptive categorical homophily and numeric age assortativity. Compare each attribute with its own matched null; do not rank unlike metrics or assert causal dominance.
replication_limit: Two generations of one roster cannot estimate between-roster uncertainty or establish general-population effects.
approval_gates: Review declared fictional adult roster and country-framing claim
Bilingual review of all translated instructions and persona values
Freeze primary contrasts, metrics, null baselines and uncertainty limitations
Verify model access, parameters, prices and whole-matrix cost with reserve
Bind runner to this exact protocol, roster and prompt hashes
Offline all-method preflight and independent review before paid authorization
